title: Anthocyanins in Black Soybean Coats Promote Apoptosis in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cells by Regulating the JAK2/STAT3 Pathway.
authors: Li, Yuying; Wang, Miaomiao; Bai, Jinjing; Li, Xin; Xiao, Sheng; Song, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黑豆种皮花青素通过JAK2/STAT3通路促进肝癌细胞凋亡，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The use of black soybean (Glycine max L.), an edible crop prevalent in Asia, has attracted attention for its hepatoprotective properties. Notably, the anthocyanin components in black soybean coats have shown potential in inhibiting tumor growth. Here, anthocyanins were extracted from black soybean coats using both microwave and water bath methods. The physicochemical characteristics of black soybean coat anthocyanins (BSCAs) and their biological activities were examined. The results from the MTT and EDU assays demonstrated a dose-dependent inhibitory effect of BSCAs on hepatocellular carcinoma HepG2 cells, while leaving normal cells unaffected. Flow cytometry and mitochondrial membrane potential assays revealed that BSCA treatment induces apoptosis in HepG2 cells. A network pharmacology approach was employed to explore the relationship between hepatocellular carcinoma and the active ingredients of BSCAs, identifying the JAK/STAT signaling pathway as a potential target. Molecular docking studies confirmed the interaction between BSCA components and JAK2/STAT3 targets. Subsequent Western blot and qPCR experiments validated that BSCAs promote apoptosis in HepG2 cells by modulating the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 黑大豆（Glycine max L.）作为一种在亚洲普遍食用的可食用作物，其保肝特性引起了关注。值得注意的是，黑大豆种皮中的花青素成分显示出抑制肿瘤生长的潜力。本研究采用微波法和水浴法从黑大豆种皮中提取花青素，并考察了黑大豆种皮花青素（BSCAs）的理化特性及其生物活性。MTT和EDU实验结果表明，BSCAs对肝细胞癌HepG2细胞具有剂量依赖性抑制作用，而对正常细胞无影响。流式细胞术和线粒体膜电位实验显示，BSCA处理可诱导HepG2细胞凋亡。采用网络药理学方法探讨肝细胞癌与BSCAs活性成分之间的关系，确定JAK/STAT信号通路为潜在靶点。分子对接研究证实了BSCA组分与JAK2/STAT3靶点之间的相互作用。随后的Western blot和qPCR实验验证了BSCAs通过调节JAK2/STAT3信号通路促进HepG2细胞凋亡。
